entities.summary: Marta Sahagún de Fox (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈmaɾta sa ˈɣun]; born Marta María Sahagún Jiménez served as the First Lady of Mexico from 2 July 2001, when she married President Vicente Fox, until he left office on 30 November 2006. Her tenure was marked by her outspoken views and active role in her husband's administration, in contrast to previous First Ladies of Mexico, as well as several controversies regarding her nonprofit Vamos México foundation and her family's business dealings.
